cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: dependent
status: specd
depends_on: 003
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-dependent.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: independent
status: specd
---
body
' > factory/specs/002-independent.md; printf -- '---
id: 003
title: dep-still-open
status: pr-open
---
body
' > factory/specs/003-dep.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; CLAIMED=$(tracker_claim specd building build-loop); jq -n --arg claimed "$CLAIMED" --arg s1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-dependent.md status)" --arg s2 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/002-independent.md status)" '{claimed: $claimed, s1: $s1, s2: $s2}'
_note: oldest spec waits on a pr-open dependency (NOT done — unmerged work is not on main); the claim must pass over it and take the next eligible item, leaving the dependent untouched
